frontmatter.name: 01-Orchestrator
frontmatter.description: Master orchestrator for the multi-step Azure platform engineering workflow. Coordinates Requirements, Architect, Design, IaC Plan, IaC Code, Deploy agents with mandatory human approval gates. Routes Bicep or Terraform tracks via decisions.iac_tool.
frontmatter.argument-hint: Describe the Azure platform engineering project you want to build end-to-end

handoffs.label: ▶ Start New Project
handoffs.prompt: Begin the multi-step workflow for a new Azure platform engineering project. Start by gathering requirements. Input: user project description. Output: project state initialized by apex/init under agent-output/{project}/.

handoffs.label: ▶ Resume Workflow
handoffs.prompt: Resume using Resuming a Project in this agent body. Input: supplied project name, or project selection when absent. Output: recovered status and the applicable approval gate or handoff, preserving required reviews and approvals.

handoffs.label: ▶ Review Artifacts
handoffs.prompt: Review all generated artifacts in the agent-output folder and provide a summary of current project state. Input: all files under agent-output/{project}/. Output: summary report of current project state (chat only).

handoffs.label: Step 1: Gather Requirements
handoffs.prompt: For a new project, begin Phase 1 Round 1 with the question tool and complete the required questioning phases before generating artifacts. The Requirements agent's session-state exception applies: on resume or refinement, recover recorded answers, ask only for missing or changed information, and preserve existing work. Input: user requirements and saved project context via apex/status. Output: agent-output/{project}/01-requirements.md with required review and approval.

handoffs.label: Step 2: Architecture Assessment
handoffs.prompt: Create a WAF assessment with cost estimates. Input: `01-requirements.md` plus `04-governance-constraints.json`. Output: `02-architecture-assessment.md`, `02-policy-map.json`, and `03-des-cost-estimate.md`.

handoffs.label: Step 3: Design Artifacts
handoffs.prompt: Generate Python architecture diagrams and ADRs based on the architecture assessment in `agent-output/{project}/02-architecture-assessment.md`. The 04-Design agent will ask which scope to produce (diagrams, ADRs, or both). This step is optional; the graph decides whether the next owner is IaC Plan.

handoffs.label: Step 3.5: Governance Discovery
handoffs.prompt: Discover Azure Policy constraints for `agent-output/{project}/`. Input: approved requirements plus subscription if available. Output: `04-governance-constraints.md/.json`, `governance_baseline`, and the Architecture handoff. Governance has no review gate.

handoffs.label: Step 4: IaC Plan (Bicep)
handoffs.prompt: Create a Bicep implementation plan. Input: `02-architecture-assessment.md`, live `04-governance-constraints.md/.json`, and `governance_baseline=live`; if the baseline is `reference` or unset, return to `04g-Governance` for Refresh Governance. Output: `04-implementation-plan.md` plus dependency/runtime diagrams. Set decisions.iac_tool to Bicep.

handoffs.label: Step 5: Generate Bicep
handoffs.prompt: Input: decisions.iac_tool=Bicep and `agent-output/{project}/04-implementation-plan.md`. Implement the Bicep templates under `infra/bicep/{project}/`. Output: selected-track infra, validation evidence, and `05-iac-handoff.json`.

handoffs.label: Step 6: Deploy (Bicep)
handoffs.prompt: Input: decisions.iac_tool=Bicep, validated `infra/bicep/{project}/`, and `05-iac-handoff.json`. Deploy after preview and approval. Output: `06-deployment-summary.md`.

handoffs.label: Step 4: IaC Plan (Terraform)
handoffs.prompt: Create a Terraform implementation plan. Input: `02-architecture-assessment.md`, live `04-governance-constraints.md/.json`, and `governance_baseline=live`; if the baseline is `reference` or unset, return to `04g-Governance` for Refresh Governance. Output: `04-implementation-plan.md` plus dependency/runtime diagrams. Set decisions.iac_tool to Terraform.

handoffs.label: Step 5: Generate Terraform
handoffs.prompt: Input: decisions.iac_tool=Terraform and `agent-output/{project}/04-implementation-plan.md`. Implement the Terraform configuration under `infra/terraform/{project}/`. Output: selected-track infra, validation evidence, and `05-iac-handoff.json`.

handoffs.label: Step 6: Deploy (Terraform)
handoffs.prompt: Input: decisions.iac_tool=Terraform, validated `infra/terraform/{project}/`, and `05-iac-handoff.json`. Deploy after preview and approval. Output: `06-deployment-summary.md`.

handoffs.label: Step 7: As-Built Documentation
handoffs.prompt: Generate the complete Step 7 documentation suite for the deployed project. Input: all prior artifacts (01-06) in `agent-output/{project}/` plus deployed resource state. Output: `07-*.md` documentation suite (design doc, runbook, cost estimate, compliance matrix, resource inventory).

handoffs.label: 🔧 Diagnose Issues
handoffs.prompt: Troubleshoot issues with the current workflow or Azure resources. Input: deployed resource state + agent-output/{project}/. Output: agent-output/{project}/diagnose-report-*.md.

handoffs.label: 🔍 Run Challenger Review
handoffs.prompt: Run an adversarial review on the artifact specified by the current gate (Requirements, Architecture, Governance, Plan, or Code). Input: artifact path passed by the orchestrator (e.g. agent-output/{project}/01-requirements.md). Output: gated reviews are recorded through apex/recordReview or ungated reviews return an inline findings summary. Re-enter the orchestrator after the user reviews the findings.

frontmatter.name: 02-Requirements
frontmatter.description: Researches and captures Azure platform engineering project requirements
frontmatter.argument-hint: Describe the Azure workload or project you want to gather requirements for

handoffs.label: ▶ Refine Requirements
handoffs.prompt: Review the current requirements document and refine based on new information or clarifications. Input: `agent-output/{project}/01-requirements.md`. Output: updated `agent-output/{project}/01-requirements.md`.

handoffs.label: ▶ Ask Clarifying Questions
handoffs.prompt: Generate clarifying questions to fill gaps in the current requirements. Focus on NFRs, compliance, budget, and regional preferences. Input: user prompt + answers gathered so far. Output: updated questioning state with no artifact yet.

handoffs.label: ▶ Validate Completeness
handoffs.prompt: Validate the requirements document for completeness against the template. Input: draft `agent-output/{project}/01-requirements.md`. Output: completeness report in chat plus revised `agent-output/{project}/01-requirements.md` if gaps are found.

handoffs.label: 🔍 Run Challenger Review
handoffs.prompt: Review the requirements artifact at `agent-output/{project}/01-requirements.md`. Input: completed requirements artifact. Output: gated review evidence recorded by apex/recordReview plus findings summary and Per-Finding Decision Protocol.

handoffs.label: Step 1.5: Governance Discovery
handoffs.prompt: Run governance discovery for a governance-first project after Gate 1. Input: approved `agent-output/{project}/01-requirements.md`, project scope and subscription if available. Output: `04-governance-constraints.md/.json`, `decisions.governance_baseline`, and handoff to `03-Architect`.

handoffs.label: Step 2: Architecture Assessment
handoffs.prompt: Legacy-order handoff after Gate 1. Review `agent-output/{project}/01-requirements.md` and create a WAF assessment with cost estimates. Output: `02-architecture-assessment.md` and `03-des-cost-estimate.md`.

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Orchestrator
handoffs.prompt: Returning from Step 1 (Requirements). Input: artifacts at `agent-output/{project}/01-requirements.md`. Output: orchestrator next-step guidance.

frontmatter.name: 03-Architect
frontmatter.description: Expert Architect providing guidance using Azure Well-Architected Framework principles and Microsoft best practices. Evaluates decisions against WAF pillars and generates ARM MCP-verified cost estimates.

handoffs.label: ▶ Refresh Cost Estimate
handoffs.prompt: Re-query Azure Resource Manager MCP through cost-estimate-subagent to update current pricing and totals. Input: agent-output/{project}/02-architecture-assessment.md SKU list. Output: agent-output/{project}/03-des-cost-estimate.md.

handoffs.label: ▶ Deep Dive WAF Pillar
handoffs.prompt: Perform a deeper analysis on a specific WAF pillar. Which pillar should I analyze in more detail? (Security, Reliability, Performance, Cost, Operations) Input: agent-output/{project}/02-architecture-assessment.md. Output: expanded pillar analysis appended to the same assessment file.

handoffs.label: ▶ Compare SKU Options
handoffs.prompt: Compare alternative SKU options for key resources. Analyze trade-offs between cost, performance, and features. Input: current SKU choices in agent-output/{project}/02-architecture-assessment.md. Output: SKU trade-off matrix written to agent-output/{project}/03-des-sku-comparison.md.

handoffs.label: Step 3: Design Artifacts
handoffs.prompt: Begin Step 3 from agent-output/{project}/02-architecture-assessment.md. Ask once for design scope (Diagrams only, ADRs only, or Both), then record design_scope. When diagrams are in scope, record diagram_tool=python and use the python-diagrams skill. Outputs: 03-des-diagram.py with PNG/SVG siblings and/or 03-des-adr-NNNN-{slug}.md.

handoffs.label: Step 3.5: Governance Discovery
handoffs.prompt: Refresh Governance. Input: approved `02-architecture-assessment.md` and subscription context. Output: refreshed `04-governance-constraints.md/.json` and `governance_baseline`.

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Step 1
handoffs.prompt: Returning to requirements for refinement. Review `agent-output/{project}/01-requirements.md` — architecture assessment identified gaps that need addressing.

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Orchestrator
handoffs.prompt: Returning from Step 2 (Architecture). Artifacts at `agent-output/{project}/02-architecture-assessment.md` and `agent-output/{project}/03-des-cost-estimate.md`. Advise on next steps.

frontmatter.name: 04-Design
frontmatter.description: Step 3 — Design Artifacts. Generates code-based Python architecture diagrams and Architecture Decision Records for approved Azure designs. Optional step before governance and IaC planning.

handoffs.label: ▶ Generate Diagram
handoffs.prompt: This handoff implies design_scope=diagrams. Record design_scope=diagrams and diagram_tool=python through apex/decide before other work. Input: agent-output/{project}/02-architecture-assessment.md. Use the python-diagrams skill and its shared diagram_io.py helper. Output: agent-output/{project}/03-des-diagram.py plus .png and .svg siblings.

handoffs.label: ▶ Generate ADR
handoffs.prompt: This handoff implies design_scope=adrs. Record it through apex/decide before other work, then create ADRs from agent-output/{project}/02-architecture-assessment.md using the azure-adr skill.

handoffs.label: ▶ Generate Cost Estimate
handoffs.prompt: Generate a detailed cost estimate through cost-estimate-subagent and Azure Resource Manager MCP. Save it to agent-output/{project}/03-des-cost-estimate.md.

handoffs.label: Step 3.5: Governance Discovery
handoffs.prompt: Discover Azure Policy constraints for agent-output/{project}/. Produce 04-governance-constraints.md and .json, then run adversarial review.

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Step 2
handoffs.prompt: Review agent-output/{project}/02-architecture-assessment.md for architecture re-evaluation.

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Orchestrator
handoffs.prompt: Return from Step 3. Input: completed artifacts under agent-output/{project}/. Output: orchestrator resume context for governance discovery or IaC planning, including Python diagram source with PNG/SVG renders, ADRs, and any optional cost estimate.

frontmatter.name: 04g-Governance
frontmatter.description: Azure governance discovery agent. Queries Azure Policy assignments or imports the reference baseline, classifies effects, emits governance constraint artifacts, records governance_baseline, and routes to Architect.
frontmatter.argument-hint: Discover governance constraints for a project

handoffs.label: ▶ Refresh Governance
handoffs.prompt: Re-run governance discovery for this project. Input: current project scope and Azure subscription. Query Azure Policy REST API, replace any reference baseline, update 04-governance-constraints.md/.json, and record `governance_baseline=live`. Output: refreshed governance artifacts and the next handoff.

handoffs.label: Step 2: Architecture Assessment
handoffs.prompt: Governance discovery is complete for a governance-first project. Input: `01-requirements.md`, `04-governance-constraints.md`, `04-governance-constraints.json`, and `decisions.governance_baseline`. Output: `02-architecture-assessment.md`, `02-policy-map.json`, and `03-des-cost-estimate.md`.

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Orchestrator
handoffs.prompt: Governance discovery is complete. Resume the workflow. Input: current phase artifacts under agent-output/{project}/. Output: control returns to 01-Orchestrator (no new artifact).

frontmatter.name: 05-IaC Planner
frontmatter.description: Expert Azure IaC planner that creates comprehensive machine-readable implementation plans. Consults Microsoft documentation, evaluates Azure Verified Modules (Bicep or Terraform), designs full infrastructure solutions with architecture diagrams. Routes by decisions.iac_tool.

handoffs.label: ▶ Refresh Governance
handoffs.prompt: Refresh Governance with live Azure Policy discovery. Input: current project scope, subscription and Step 4 block reason (`governance_baseline_reference`, `governance_baseline_unset`, stale L0 metadata, or policy drift). Output: `04-governance-constraints.md/.json` and `governance_baseline=live`.

handoffs.label: ▶ Revise Plan
handoffs.prompt: Revise the implementation plan based on new information or feedback. Update `agent-output/{project}/04-implementation-plan.md`.

handoffs.label: ▶ Compare AVM Modules
handoffs.prompt: Query AVM metadata for all planned resources. Compare available vs required parameters and flag any gaps. Input: agent-output/{project}/04-implementation-plan.md current module choices. Output: AVM trade-off matrix appended to the implementation plan.

handoffs.label: Step 5: Generate Bicep
handoffs.prompt: Input: decisions.iac_tool=Bicep and `agent-output/{project}/04-implementation-plan.md`. Output: Bicep implementation under `infra/bicep/{project}/`, validation evidence, and `05-iac-handoff.json`.

handoffs.label: Step 5: Generate Terraform
handoffs.prompt: Input: decisions.iac_tool=Terraform and `agent-output/{project}/04-implementation-plan.md`. Output: Terraform implementation under `infra/terraform/{project}/`, validation evidence, and `05-iac-handoff.json`.

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Step 2
handoffs.prompt: Returning to architecture assessment for re-evaluation. Review `agent-output/{project}/02-architecture-assessment.md` — WAF scores and recommendations may need adjustment.

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Orchestrator
handoffs.prompt: Returning from Step 4 (IaC Planning). Artifacts at `agent-output/{project}/04-implementation-plan.md` and `agent-output/{project}/04-governance-constraints.md`. Advise on next steps.

frontmatter.name: 06-IaC CodeGen
frontmatter.description: Creates approved Azure IaC for the selected track. Reads iac_tool, loads Bicep or Terraform skills, validates with the merged worker, and emits Step 5 handoff artifacts.

handoffs.label: Run Preflight Check
handoffs.prompt: Input: project slug and current Step 4 artifacts. Run the selected-track preflight from `agent-output/{project}/04-implementation-plan.md` and save `agent-output/{project}/04-preflight-check.md`. Output: blockers, decisions, and next CodeGen phase.

handoffs.label: Fix Validation Errors
handoffs.prompt: Input: validation output from `iac-validate-subagent` and current infra tree. Fix only the selected track's files in `infra/{bicep|terraform}/{project}/`, then re-run validation. Output: patched infra files plus passing validator evidence.

handoffs.label: Generate Implementation Reference
handoffs.prompt: Input: selected track, generated infra tree, and validation status. Generate or update `agent-output/{project}/05-implementation-reference.md` and `05-iac-handoff.json`. Output: implementation reference and handoff contract.

handoffs.label: Step 6: Deploy
handoffs.prompt: Input: selected track from `decisions.iac_tool`, validated infra under `infra/{bicep|terraform}/{project}/`, and `agent-output/{project}/05-iac-handoff.json`. Output: deploy preview and Step 6 deployment summary.

handoffs.label: Return to Step 4
handoffs.prompt: Input: implementation findings that require plan revision. Output: updated `agent-output/{project}/04-implementation-plan.md` and current review evidence.

handoffs.label: Return to Orchestrator
handoffs.prompt: Input: Step 5 completion status and selected track. Output: workflow routing after `05-implementation-reference.md` and `05-iac-handoff.json` are current.

frontmatter.name: 07-IaC Deploy
frontmatter.description: Executes approved Azure deployments for the selected IaC track. Runs Bicep what-if or Terraform plan plus live policy precheck before explicit apply approval.
frontmatter.argument-hint: Deploy the approved IaC for a specific project

handoffs.label: Run Preview Only
handoffs.prompt: Input: selected track from `decisions.iac_tool`, current infra tree, parameters or tfvars, and target scope. Run Bicep what-if or Terraform plan plus live policy precheck. Output: preview report only; no resources deployed.

handoffs.label: Deploy Next Phase
handoffs.prompt: Input: selected track and `agent-output/{project}/04-implementation-plan.md`. Deploy the next uncompleted phase after preview, policy precheck, and explicit approval. Output: updated `06-deployment-summary.md`.

handoffs.label: Deploy All Phases
handoffs.prompt: Input: selected track and approved phase plan. Deploy all remaining phases sequentially with preview, live policy precheck, and approval gates between phases. Output: deployment summary per completed phase.

handoffs.label: Retry Deployment
handoffs.prompt: Input: previous deployment error and `agent-output/{project}/06-deployment-summary.md`. Re-run preflight validation, preview, policy precheck, and approval-bound apply with the same selected track. Output: updated deployment summary.

handoffs.label: Verify Resources
handoffs.prompt: Input: deployed resource group, Terraform outputs when applicable, and deployment summary. Query Azure Resource Graph and resource health. Output: verification table appended to `agent-output/{project}/06-deployment-summary.md`.

handoffs.label: Step 7: As-Built Documentation
handoffs.prompt: Input: successful deployment summary at `agent-output/{project}/06-deployment-summary.md` plus prior artifacts. Output: complete Step 7 as-built documentation suite.

handoffs.label: Fix Deployment Issues
handoffs.prompt: Input: selected track, deployment error log, and current infra tree. Output: patched infra files plus fresh preview and validation evidence.

handoffs.label: Return to Step 2
handoffs.prompt: Input: deployment results requiring architecture review. Output: updated WAF assessment and design disposition.

handoffs.label: Return to Orchestrator
handoffs.prompt: Input: Step 6 deployment status and `agent-output/{project}/06-deployment-summary.md`. Output: routing to as-built documentation or recovery.

frontmatter.name: 08-As-Built
frontmatter.description: Generates Step 7 as-built documentation suite after successful deployment. Reads all prior artifacts (Steps 1-6) and deployed resource state to produce: design document, operations runbook, cost estimate, compliance matrix, backup/DR plan, resource inventory, and documentation index.

handoffs.label: ▶ Generate All Documentation
handoffs.prompt: Generate the complete Step 7 documentation suite for the deployed project. Read all prior artifacts in `agent-output/{project}/` and query deployed resources. Input: agent-output/{project}/06-deployment-summary.md + deployed resource state. Output: full as-built suite at agent-output/{project}/07-*.md.

handoffs.label: ▶ Generate As-Built Diagram
handoffs.prompt: Generate as-built Mermaid diagrams through apex/renderDocument from structured Step 7 sources. Input: 07-resource-inventory.json plus deployment evidence. Output: Mermaid blocks embedded in rendered Step 7 Markdown. Python diagrams are optional contributor extras only.

handoffs.label: ▶ Generate Cost Estimate Only
handoffs.prompt: Generate only the as-built cost estimate (`agent-output/{project}/07-ab-cost-estimate.md`). Query deployed resources for actual SKUs, then delegate pricing to cost-estimate-subagent. Use subagent-returned prices verbatim.

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Orchestrator
handoffs.prompt: Returning from Step 7 (As-Built Documentation). Complete documentation suite generated at `agent-output/{project}/07-*.md` including design document, operations runbook, cost estimate, compliance matrix, and resource inventory. Workflow is complete.

frontmatter.name: 09-Diagnose
frontmatter.description: Interactive diagnostic agent that guides users through Azure resource health assessment, issue identification, and remediation planning. Scope-first execution with approval for every change, single-resource scope, reports to agent-output/{project}/.

handoffs.label: ▶ Expand Scope
handoffs.prompt: Expand the diagnostic scope to include related resources. Query resource dependencies and assess health of connected resources. Input: current resource under diagnosis + sibling resource group. Output: expanded findings in agent-output/{project}/08-resource-health-report.md.

handoffs.label: ▶ Deep Dive Logs
handoffs.prompt: Perform deep log analysis on the current resource. Query activity logs and diagnostic logs for detailed error information. Input: Application Insights / Log Analytics workspace ID. Output: log analysis section appended to agent-output/{project}/08-resource-health-report.md.

handoffs.label: ▶ Re-run Health Check
handoffs.prompt: Re-run the resource health assessment to check for status changes after remediation actions. Input: current diagnostic target resource ID. Output: refreshed health snapshot in agent-output/{project}/08-resource-health-report.md.

handoffs.label: ▶ Generate Workload Documentation
handoffs.prompt: Generate as-built documentation incorporating health assessment findings from `agent-output/{project}/08-resource-health-report.md`. Input: all prior artifacts + diagnostic report. Output: `07-*.md` documentation suite.

handoffs.label: ↩ Escalate to Architect
handoffs.prompt: Completed a resource health assessment that identified architectural issues requiring WAF evaluation. Please review the findings in `agent-output/{project}/08-resource-health-report.md` and provide architectural recommendations.

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Orchestrator
handoffs.prompt: Returning from Diagnostics. Report at `agent-output/{project}/08-resource-health-report.md`. Advise on next steps.

frontmatter.name: 10-Challenger
frontmatter.description: Standalone adversarial review entry point. Runs gated reviews through apex/reviewRequest, rubber-duck, and apex/recordReview, or ungated rubber-duck reviews inline, then runs the Per-Finding Decision Protocol.
frontmatter.argument-hint: Provide the path to the artifact to challenge (e.g. agent-output/my-project/04-implementation-plan.md)

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Orchestrator
handoffs.prompt: Challenge complete. Input: challenged artifact, resolved findings_path and decisions_path from the canonical path mapping, and apply summary. Output: control returns to 01-Orchestrator for the owning step; no new artifact beyond findings, decisions and approved in-place edits. Carry the actual resolved paths, not artifact_type-derived filenames.

frontmatter.name: 11-Context Optimizer
frontmatter.description: Analyzes Copilot Chat debug logs to audit context-window utilization across agents. Identifies bloated prompts, redundant file reads, missing hand-off points, and wasted tokens. Produces actionable optimization reports. Recommendations only — never edits agents.

handoffs.label: ↩ Return to Orchestrator
handoffs.prompt: Completed context optimization audit. Report saved. Advise on next steps. Input: current phase artifacts under agent-output/{project}/. Output: control returns to 01-Orchestrator (no new artifact).

frontmatter.name: challenger-review-subagent
frontmatter.description: Unified adversarial review subagent that challenges Azure infrastructure artifacts. Finds untested assumptions, governance gaps, WAF blind spots, and architectural weaknesses. Returns structured JSON findings. Supports single-pass and multi-pass rotating-lens reviews; batches lenses per invocation.

frontmatter.name: cost-estimate-subagent
frontmatter.description: Azure cost estimation subagent. Uses Azure Resource Manager MCP retail pricing and cost data, then returns a structured cost breakdown through a file-based contract.

frontmatter.name: iac-preview-subagent
frontmatter.description: IaC preview worker for Bicep or Terraform. Runs Bicep what-if or Terraform plan plus live Azure Policy precheck and returns preview summary with deterministic deploy gate.

frontmatter.name: iac-validate-subagent
frontmatter.description: IaC validation worker for Bicep or Terraform. Runs track lint/build or fmt/validate, reviews AVM/AVM-TF, security, RBAC and governance, and returns the existing verdict contract.
